edges.name: Canonical registry → definitions

edges.name: Registry → technical demonstration
edges.boundary: Indexing does not certify global Chronos/URF–RR closure.
edges.evidence: Vasquez Index README names Chronos as its technical demonstration.

edges.name: Registry → explanation layer
edges.boundary: Exposition is not kernel verification.
edges.evidence: Vasquez Index README names URF textbook as its explanation layer.

edges.name: Registry → status transparency
edges.boundary: Status transparency does not establish theorem closure.
edges.evidence: Vasquez Index README describes the dashboard as a public status layer.

edges.name: Registry → public spine audit
edges.boundary: The public spine is not theorem-prover-complete.
edges.evidence: Vasquez Index README explicitly links the sanitized public spine.

edges.name: Logic library → canonical definitions
edges.boundary: Shared routing does not prove a locality-to-global reconstruction theorem.
edges.evidence: CSLIB README states canonical URF definitions and closure claims remain in URF Core.

edges.name: Profile → research website
edges.boundary: Website publication verifies no mathematics.
edges.evidence: Profile README explicitly links the research website.

edges.name: Website → research registry
edges.boundary: Navigation is an evidence access path only.
edges.evidence: Public website README explicitly links the Vasquez Index.

edges.name: Chronos release → research source
edges.boundary: Signed artifacts certify only their specified scope.
edges.evidence: Both publicly describe conditional Chronos research and release evidence.

edges.name: Certificate checks ↔ schema layer
edges.boundary: Certificate validity is not theorem truth.
edges.evidence: URF verifier is a certificate infrastructure layer; URF Core defines verification objects.

edges.name: Reproducible template → verifier workflow
edges.boundary: A passing bounded demonstration is not full-science validation.
edges.evidence: URF templates README defines claim → artifact → verifier → boundary workflow.

edges.name: Closure ledgers ↔ status reporting
edges.boundary: Classification and status checks cannot close missing proofs.
edges.evidence: Both explicitly track theorem-boundary status, not mathematical closure.

edges.name: Finite reconstruction → 3D topology
edges.boundary: Need a topology-sensitive nonabelian invariant and a universal descent/recognition transfer under actual triangulation hypotheses.
edges.evidence: Local observation-kernel data do not alone distinguish all 3-manifold fundamental groups.

edges.name: Observation equivalence → logical locality
edges.boundary: Need an EF extension/quantifier-rank preservation theorem for the specified class.
edges.evidence: The existing routing is documented, but the proposed theorem remains separate.

edges.name: Locality → fixed FO⁴ constraints
edges.boundary: Need a proved interpretation preserving four-variable budget and constraints.
edges.evidence: FO⁴ repository explicitly limits itself to constraint isolation.

edges.name: Reconstruction → computational lower bounds
edges.boundary: Need adversarial lower-bound reduction, with the observation model and resources specified.
edges.evidence: An oracle information bound does not imply general SAT hardness.

edges.name: Abstract reconstruction → transfer registry
edges.boundary: Need one assumption-preserving, source-checked cross-domain transfer theorem.
edges.evidence: Registry records translations and dependencies, not closure.

edges.name: Restricted schemas → closure transfer
edges.boundary: Need a concrete reduction preserving the precise restricted boundary objects.
edges.evidence: Neither repository claims unrestricted global closure.

edges.name: Observation quotients → biological systems
edges.boundary: Need a defined measurable biological observation map and experimentally testable discriminant.
edges.evidence: Abstract quotient factorization does not validate biological models.

edges.name: Spacetime reduction → effective cosmology
edges.boundary: Need a consistent field/action map with matching coefficients, predictions and uncertainty.
edges.evidence: Bounded computational agreement is not a universal physical identification.

edges.name: Effective physics → null-test observable
edges.boundary: Need an apparatus-dependent prediction distinguishable from known 4D physics and real measurements.
edges.evidence: The null-test repository states no measured anomaly or new physics.

edges.name: Closure schemas → audited conclusion
edges.boundary: Need complete hypotheses and a formally checked necessity/sufficiency ledger.
edges.evidence: Restricted closure schema cannot imply unrestricted completeness.

edges.name: Finite holonomy → geometric lift
edges.boundary: Need an explicit functor/representation from finite observation and transport data to a circle bundle with connection, preserving stated invariants.
edges.evidence: Holonomy can already exist in four-dimensional gauge theory; a fifth dimension is not forced.

edges.name: 5D metric → 4D spacetime model
edges.boundary: Need a 5D parent action, reduction and field-equation match. The restricted 4D event-statistic response Jacobian is nonsingular, but is not evidence for a fifth dimension.
edges.evidence: A possible KK metric does not validate the physical theory.

edges.name: Geometric lift → effective action
edges.boundary: Need a complete 5D parent action and reduction reproducing all specified 4D terms with correct coefficients.
edges.evidence: Coefficient-level overlap is conditional; full uplift remains OPEN.

edges.name: Holonomy invariants → topology
edges.boundary: Need a nonabelian/global invariant and an independent theorem linking it to 3D recognition/descent.
edges.evidence: Abelian H¹/holonomy alone cannot resolve the Poincaré homology-sphere obstruction.

edges.name: Geometric locality ↔ logical locality
edges.boundary: Need a semantics-preserving interpretation between geometric bounded observations and finite-model-theoretic formulas.
edges.evidence: These notions of locality are not automatically equivalent.

edges.name: 5D-specific measurable signature
edges.boundary: Need a predicted observable that differs from competing 4D gauge models, then controlled real-data falsification.
edges.evidence: The present null-test is schema-only; no anomaly measured.

edges.name: Merged BFF–URF observation-quotient interface
edges.boundary: The merged isolated observation-factorization candidate is abstract; it does not prove a biological observation-map theorem or clinical validity. README's CI status requires independent rechecking.
edges.evidence: BFF PR #109 merged; its public observation-bridge README explicitly relates exact quotient decoding to URF Core while retaining biological and verification boundaries.

edges.name: Merged Chronos–FMT candidate locality research note
edges.boundary: Documentation-only link. The FMT radius-ball and game semantics have not been shown equivalent to independently gauge-quotiented proper-path observations; no general locality or 5D theorem.
edges.evidence: Chronos PR #1340 merged at 250b85478a116c7608fdb7bc7def29fc36cb5eed, introducing a conditional finite-holonomy/FMT interface note.
